disputes.escalateReasonTooShort: Reason must be at least 10 characters.
disputes.lockNote: This locks the dispute as ARBITRATION_PENDING — in-platform mediation ends, parties get a notification, arbitration is handled out-of-platform.

disputes.reasoningLabel: Reasoning (≥30 chars, shown to both parties)
disputes.reasoningPlaceholder: e.g. Worker delivered 60% of agreed scope per chat evidence; employer's complaints about quality not substantiated by submitted artifacts.
disputes.reasoningTooShort: Reasoning must be at least 30 characters.
disputes.title: Escrow disputes

rules.adminOnlyNote: Only admins can create or deactivate rules.
rules.editDesc: Update the name, description, active state — or tweak the condition values (thresholds, role names, document types). Target action, approver role and the set of condition types are immutable — deactivate and create a new rule to change them.
rules.editNote: Condition values are editable above (e.g. change the AMOUNT_GT threshold or the required role). Condition types are immutable — deactivate this rule and create a new one to add or remove conditions.
rules.existingDesc: Rules are AND-ed against incoming actions. A match queues the request for the required approver role.
rules.name: Name
rules.newDesc: Pick an action, the approver role, and any conditions that must all match for the rule to fire.
rules.noRulesDesc: Create your first rule on the right — every admin action will run immediately until you do.
rules.onlyValidPost: are shown. Switching the action will drop incompatible conditions.

settings.accountRefHint: Paid to referrer on every released milestone where the referree is a party. Default 10%.
settings.accountWindowHint: How long the referrer keeps earning from the referree's contracts after signup. Default 12 months.
settings.clientFeeHint: Charged to employer on top of agreed amount (Upwork pattern). Default 5%.
settings.feesDesc: These percentages drive escrow fee math. Changes apply to NEW milestone funding only — in-flight contracts use the snapshot frozen at first-fund. Audit-logged.
settings.passthroughHint: Stripe takes 1.5% + 20p per UK card transaction.
settings.referralDesc: Sum of all referrer cuts on a milestone is capped at 100% of the platform fee — worker payout is never reduced. Account referrals pay from platform fee; project referrals pay from agreed amount.
settings.w2wRefHint: A worker or employer shares a job link → a worker applies and is hired. Default 2%.

sla.adminOnlyNote: Only admins can create or deactivate rules.
sla.breachesDesc: Items overdue for at least one active rule. Resolved breaches drop off automatically when the underlying row leaves its queue.
sla.editDesc: Tweak the threshold, name, description or notification copy. Queue is immutable.
sla.newDesc: Pick a queue and how long an item is allowed to wait before it's flagged.
sla.noBreachesDesc: Every queue is within its SLA window.
sla.noRulesDesc: Create one on the right to start watching a queue.
sla.rulesDesc: Notifications are in-platform only (notification bell) and go to staff — never to clients. Each breach pings all active admins plus the per-item assignee if there is one (review_item, dispute or support thread). SLA rules themselves don't have an assignee — that's a per-row concept.
